featureNames.description: The names of the features that data should be retrieved for.

assetId.description: The id of the asset that the features are associated with.

isValidation.description:
If true, model validation types should be queried. Otherwise, normal model types should be queried.

More specifically, if true, a {@link ReliabilityAssetToModelValidationRelation} instance should be
the source of truth. If false, a {@link ReliabilityAssetToModelRelation} instance should be the source of truth.

fetchSpec.description:
Used to mimic the behavior of a {@Persistable#fetch} despite {@link FeatureFetchBase} querying
multiple different types.

Relevant Fields in this spec:
 - {@link FetchSpec#asOf}: Specifies the timestamp on which feature data should be returned for.
 - {@link FetchSpec#include}: Specifies what data should be queried for each feature. This include string can include
the following fields: `expectedSensor, value, variance, sensorAlert, contribution, reconstruction, contributionPercentage`.
 - {@link FetchSpec#order}: Specifies how to sort the data. Typical order string format can be used. Any fields to
be ordered on are also included automatically.
 - {@link FetchSpec#offset} and {@link FetchSpec#limit}: Used to slice the returned features in memory.
Used for pagination.
 - {@link FetchSpec#filter}: Applies the filter expression to each feature using the {@link Obj#at} api.

title:
A {@link FeatureFetchBaseTargetSpec} with additional fields that specify precomputed values
and a {@link FetchSpec} completes the context required to fetch features as if doing a {@link Persistable#fetch}.
name: FeatureFetchBaseSpec
